name: Gumshoe TV
description: Trench coats, fedoras and just the facts: Dragnet, Sherlock Holmes (1954), Johnny Staccato, Man with a Camera, Racket Squad, Decoy, Treasury Men in Action, Highway Patrol, Michael Shayne, Martin Kane and Rocky King. Peter Gunn works the case weeknights at 9:00 pm, in episode order.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 150 hours of 1949-61 detective and police TV episodes from whole-series items and the Classic TV collection; Peter Gunn slot from the season 2 item. Excluded the 1984 Mike Hammer series, the 1975 Ellery Queen, colorized uploads, the theatrical Boston Blackie and Sherlock Holmes films, and untitled or duplicate Boston Blackie and Racket Squad uploads.
